itineraryDays.route: Explore the Ancient Imperial City of Hue Half-day (Join Group)
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Everyone will gather at 08:00 to get ready for a half-day trip around the ancient city of Hue. Kick off the journey as we hop on a Dragon Boat Trip. Floating through the Perfume River, tourists can immerse in the serene beauty of this city. Our first destination is Thien Mu Pagoda - a hundred year-old Buddhist temple which is the oldest temple in Hue. Then, be captivated by the breathtaking architecture and the serene ambience surroundings that grace the expansive Imperial Citadel , the former residence of the Nguyen emperors - the last journey of the feudal period in Vietnam. Immerse in the old-aged stories by the tour guide while wandering around, it opens in your mind much more insights of this charming Hue city. Finally, make a quick pause at Dong Ba Market - the biggest traditional trading hub in Hue, for a shopping opportunity. At Dong Ba, your group not only can purchase interesting souvenirs but also gain insight into the daily business practices of local sellers. Also, tasting street food at the market is an absolute must-try experience. So, make sure you have a little time for that. Afternoon The afternoon is free for you to discover Hue on your own. If you’d like to make the most of your time, we offer a selection of optional tours carefully designed to enrich your journey. itineraryDays.summary: Morning Today we will move out of the hotel in Hue to overnight at Hoi An. After breakfast and the check-out session, your group will be transferred to Hoi An Town . Afternoon Following the hotel check-in procedures, tourists will have all the time left in the day to enjoy their vacation in Hoi An Ancient Town . You can explore the streets that are filled with the laid-back atmosphere and all the beautiful lanterns hanging around. If you need an expert to guide, you should book a half-day tour below to have an exciting well-planned itinerary for you: Hoi An: Half-Day Walking City Tour‎ FROM US $34 /pax Hoi An Motorbike Street Food Tour Half Day FROM US $49 /pax Cooking Class Half-day Tour in Hoi An: FROM US $67 /pax

itineraryDays.route: My Son Holly Land - Tracing the Ancient Cham Civilization
itineraryDays.summary: Option : Morning Journey or Sunset Experience Begin your experience with a convenient pick-up from your hotel in the heart of Hoi An, then set off towards the enchanting My Son Sanctuary — a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site hidden within a lush, tranquil valley. Wander through the ancient temple complex, where timeworn red-brick towers stand quietly amid the surrounding greenery. As you explore, your guide will bring the fascinating history of the Champa Kingdom to life, while a traditional performance adds a vivid cultural touch to your journey. Continue to a local home for a hands-on rice paper making experience, where you can try this simple yet meaningful craft and taste your own creation. Afterwards, relax in a peaceful countryside setting with a home-hosted meal, featuring fresh local dishes and herbal tea. Note : For the sunset option, this experience is replaced with a light snack such as banh mi and coconut Conclude your day with a relaxing boat ride along the Thu Bon River. Enjoy the cool breeze and peaceful scenery as you return to Hoi An.
itineraryDays.title: My Son Holly Land - Tracing the Ancient Cham Civilization

itineraryDays.route: Hanoi Arrival – Food Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in Hanoi for check-in and some time to relax before your evening adventure. At around 17:30 , our tour guide will meet you in front of Shinhan Bank, 14 Le Thai To Street, Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, and escort you on a delightful Hanoi Street Food Tour . This walking-and-eating journey will lead you through the bustling Old Quarter, where you’ll discover both the flavors and the charm of local life. The menu may vary depending on the day, but typical dishes often include: Pho Bo (Vietnamese Beef Noodles), Bun Thang (Rice Vermicelli with Chicken and Eggs), or Bun Bo Hue, all representing Hanoi’s rich noodle culture. Savory quick bites such as Banh Cuon (Steamed Rice Rolls) and Banh Mi (Vietnamese bread). Local street snacks like Nom Bo Kho (Dried Beef Salad) and Nem Chua Ran (Fried Fermented Pork Roll). To finish, you’ll enjoy Ca Phe Trung (Egg Coffee), a Hanoi specialty loved by both locals and visitors. Note : If you have dietary requirements (vegetarian, vegan, allergies, etc.), please inform us in advance so the menu can be adjusted.
itineraryDays.title: Hanoi Arrival – Food Tour

itineraryDays.route: Hanoi Half-day City Tour - Bus To Sapa
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Begin your second day of travel with a city tour in Hanoi and learn more about the ancient capital. You acquaint yourself with Hanoi Old Quarter's serene atmosphere and these must-visit sites: Start exploring Vietnam's earliest university, the Temple of Literature , where the country's aristocracy, mandarins, and elite learned. Come to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum , where the legendary founding father of contemporary Vietnam is currently resting in eternal peace. Then head to One Pillar Pagoda , the most famous one in Vietnam has a unique design like a lotus blooming from water. Visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum In Hanoi Stop at West Lake and Tran Quoc Buddhist Pagoda , which is the oldest pagoda in Hanoi with a more than 1,500-year history. Emerge yourself in the ancient architecture from the Ly dynasty period and the fresh atmosphere of West Lake. Lunch will be provided at an authentic Vietnamese restaurant. NOTE : Depending on your schedule, you can leave in the morning or the afternoon. Routes may alter based on customer interests. (The morning tour starts at 08:00 while the afternoon one is at 13:30 ). Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum will be seen from the outside from June to August. You must dress formally so shorts, miniskirts, sleeveless shirts, and tank tops are not allowed. Afternoon Around 14:30 , you will board a comfortable bus to Sapa, passing through picturesque landscapes of rolling hills and terraced rice fields. As you travel, take in the breathtaking views of the countryside and the mist-covered mountains. Upon arrival in Sapa, you will check in to your hotel, where you can relax and refresh after the journey, preparing for the exciting adventures ahead in this stunning highland region.
itineraryDays.title: Hanoi Half-day City Tour - Bus To Sapa

itineraryDays.route: Trekking to Ethnic Villages in Sapa - Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van
itineraryDays.summary: Distance & Est. time: Trekking 13 km Have breakfast at your hotel before beginning your trekking adventure in Lao Cai with our local tour guide. The trekking path includes Y Linh Ho , a tiny town located beside the Muong Hoa River, and Lao Chai , a Black Hmong community famed for its remarkable indigo blue clothes and vestiges of history. After lunch, spend time learning about the local culture and then return to Sapa and continue to visit Ta Van Village , a Zay people's settlement. You will see the houses of this ethnic minority built among the poetic terraced fields. Back to the town and spend the night at the hotel. NOTE : The trekking path is about 13 km downhill and it is the easy level.
itineraryDays.title: Trekking to Ethnic Villages in Sapa - Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van

itineraryDays.route: Fansipan – Back to Hanoi
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After enjoying a hearty breakfast in Sapa, you will be transferred to the Fansipan Cable Car Station for an extraordinary journey. Step into the cable car and glide over the majestic Hoang Lien Son mountain range, admiring breathtaking views of terraced valleys and mist-covered peaks below. To conquer the “Roof of Indochina,” prepare for a climb of about 600 stone steps, which typically takes 1.5 hours. Upon reaching the summit of Fansipan (3,143m), you’ll be rewarded with sweeping panoramic views that stretch across mountains, valleys, and distant horizons. Take your time to explore the summit area and capture memorable photographs of this remarkable achievement. Afternoon In the afternoon, descend Fansipan by cable car, savoring the last glimpses of the mountain landscape. Afterwards, you will begin the journey back to Hanoi, bringing your Sapa adventure to a close.
itineraryDays.title: Fansipan – Back to Hanoi

itineraryDays.route: Hanoi - Overnight Cruise in Halong Bay
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Around 08:00 - 08:30 , have breakfast at the hotel before being transferred to the well-known Northern destination: Halong Bay . The check-in time on the cruise is 11:30 - 12:00 . You will be welcomed by kind crew staff with a free cool welcome drink and enjoy a delicious lunch with seafood made by professional chefs. There is beautiful emerald water and thousands of giant to small strange limestone islands that you should take in while savoring lunch. Afternoon Enroll in some activities after the break, such as a tour to the caverns in Halong Bay, kayaking, or swimming in the clear waters of a lovely beach (exact activities will depend on the schedule of each trip). Return to your ship so you may rest and have dinner. While having a great time on the cruise, you can also take part in squid fishing, card games, and watch films (depending on the cruise’s facilities).
itineraryDays.title: Hanoi - Overnight Cruise in Halong Bay

itineraryDays.route: Disembark Halong Bay Cruise - Return to Hanoi
itineraryDays.summary: Morning A Tai Chi lesson before breakfast in the early morning will give you a fresh start on your second day in Halong. (This activity may be different with some cruises so you should ask our sales consultant for details.) After that, the boat will take you to see the last attraction on the itinerary, you can visit one of the most beautiful caves: Trung Trang Cave, Sung Sot Cave, Dark & Bright Cave, etc. Check out and head to the restaurant for brunch, which is provided on the way to the cruise return to the main port. Around 11:30 , disembark and take a transfer back to Hanoi. Notes : If you need an extra night in Hanoi, please contact our travel consultants to get the best support. The attractions you will visit in the morning will depend on the itinerary of the cruise you choose.
itineraryDays.title: Disembark Halong Bay Cruise - Return to Hanoi

itineraryDays.route: Crawl Through History - Cu Chi Tunnels & Ho Chi Minh City Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Fulfill your breakfast for a busy day. And around 08:00, our car will take you to the Cu Chi Tunnels . Listen to thrilling stories through a movie about the Vietnam War in Cu Chi. Then, walk deep into the underground tunnel and admire the network to understand the life of Vietnamese soldiers during the Vietnam War. For a hands-on experience, try the shooting ranges where you can fire historic weapons like AK-47s (with surcharge). The site also has a museum with artifacts and exhibits about the war. Go inside the jungle, where you can find traps, secret entrances, bunkers, and underground hideouts. Cu Chi Tunnels provides a mix of history, hands-on activities, and reflection, making it a compelling visit for anyone interested in Vietnam's past. Stop for a light lunch at a local restaurant before returning to Ho Chi Minh City. Afternoon Back in Ho Chi Minh City, we continue the city sightseeing at the highlight historical landmarks around. Coming to the Reunification Palace was the official residence and working place of the President of the Republic of Vietnam before April 30, 1975. Today, this place is considered a monument to Vietnam's victory over independence and reunification. Admire the French colonial architecture of Notre Dame Cathedral and the Old Post Office . Both of these buildings are delicate works of the cultural interference of Vietnam in the renovation period and the French colonial period. Note : The Notre Dame Cathedral is currently under renovation. Continue visiting the War Remnants Museum , where you can witness firsthand the artifacts recording a fierce war in Vietnam. Walk around Ben Thanh market , where you can practice your bargaining skills and find unique local gifts for relatives and friends. After returning to your hotel, freely explore fanciful Ho Chi Minh by night.
itineraryDays.title: Crawl Through History - Cu Chi Tunnels & Ho Chi Minh City Tour

itineraryDays.route: Journey to the Mekong Delta - Can Tho
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Recharge your energy with breakfast and process checkout. Our transfer and guide will meet you at the lobby for the trip to the mysterious Mekong Delta . Upon arrival at My Tho City, we drop in Vinh Trang Pagoda , the best-known Buddhist temple in Southern Vietnam. Spend three hours rowed sampan by locals into the Mekong River's narrow waterways and mangrove forest. After that, visit some tropical plantations on a nearby island, and watch the natives create coconut candy while sampling some of these delectable treats. Experience sitting on 'Xe Loi' through the hamlet and try fresh fruits and honey bees. Then, have lunch at a lovely restaurant overlooking the river and try regional delicacies. Afternoon Transfer to Can Tho , where you may spend the night and take in the sights.
itineraryDays.title: Journey to the Mekong Delta - Can Tho

itineraryDays.route: Explore Cai Rang Floating Market at Dawn
itineraryDays.summary: Morning You will be picked up from your hotel and taken to the pier to board a wooden boat heading to the Cai Rang floating market , one of the most lively markets in the Mekong Delta. During the boat trip, you’ll get a closer look at local life on the water, stop by a small noodle workshop, and enjoy some fresh tropical fruits as you cruise back. Afternoon After the visit, you will check out of the hotel and begin the journey back to Ho Chi Minh City. A tasty lunch will be served at the Mekong Rest Stop along the way. The tour ends upon your arrival in Ho Chi Minh City.
itineraryDays.title: Explore Cai Rang Floating Market at Dawn

itineraryDays.route: Depart Ho Chi Minh City

Process check out; our transfer will take you to the airport to catch your flight. Thank you for accompanying Best Price in the past travel days. Hope to see you next time!
itineraryDays.title: Depart Ho Chi Minh City

itineraryDays.route: Half-day Hanoi City Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning/ Afternoon Discover some of Hanoi’s most significant cultural and historical landmarks during a half-day city tour. Visit the Temple of Literature , Vietnam’s first national university, founded in the 11th century and dedicated to Confucius. The complex offers insight into the country’s educational traditions and architectural heritage. Continue to the One Pillar Pagoda , a distinctive Buddhist temple designed to resemble a lotus flower emerging from the water. Explore the area surrounding the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum , an important historical site dedicated to Vietnam’s former leader, President Ho Chi Minh. Visit Tran Quoc Pagoda , one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Vietnam, situated on a small island along the shores of West Lake. Enjoy the peaceful scenery of West Lake , the largest freshwater lake in Hanoi, before having lunch at a local restaurant. After the tour, the remainder of the day is free at leisure. NOTE : The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is closed on Mondays and Fridays and typically undergoes annual maintenance from June to August.
itineraryDays.title: Half-day Hanoi City Tour

itineraryDays.route: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, depart Hanoi for Halong Bay , a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its limestone islands and scenic landscapes. Between 08:00 and 08:30 , you will be collected from your hotel and transferred to the cruise port, a journey of approximately 2.5-3 hours. Upon arrival, complete the check-in before boarding your cruise. Around noon, receive a welcome briefing and safety introduction. Lunch will be served as the cruise begins its journey through the bay, offering views of the surrounding limestone formations and emerald waters. Afternoon After some time to relax, participate in the cruise’s scheduled activities. Depending on the selected vessel and itinerary, activities may include kayaking, swimming, rowing boat excursions, cycling, cave visits, or sightseeing. Return to the cruise in the late afternoon and enjoy the changing scenery as the sun sets over the bay. Some cruises also offer a Vietnamese cooking demonstration or Happy Hour programme. Evening Dinner is served onboard, featuring a selection of local and international dishes. After dinner, you may join optional evening activities such as squid fishing, board games, film screenings, or simply relax on the sundeck and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the bay. NOTE : The activities of the Halong Bay cruise tour depend on each cruise’s itinerary.
itineraryDays.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise

itineraryDays.route: Halong Bay - Hanoi - Flight to Da Nang
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Start the day with an optional Tai Chi session on the sundeck while enjoying the peaceful morning atmosphere of Halong Bay. After breakfast, continue exploring the bay according to your cruise itinerary. Depending on the selected cruise, activities may include visiting Trung Trang Cave, exploring other limestone caves, or climbing Titop Island for panoramic views of the surrounding seascape. Return to the cruise for check-out procedures. Enjoy brunch onboard as the vessel sails back toward the harbour. Disembark at noon and transfer back to the mainland. Afternoon Meet your driver and transfer directly to the airport for your flight from Hanoi to Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, meet your driver and continue to Hoi An for hotel check-in.
itineraryDays.title: Halong Bay - Hanoi - Flight to Da Nang

itineraryDays.route: Half-day Hoi An Walking Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Discover the cultural heritage and architectural character of Hoi An Ancient Town on a guided walking tour. Begin at Hoi An Market , where local vendors offer fresh produce, regional specialties, and handcrafted goods, providing insight into daily life in the town. Continue to the Phuc Kien Chinese Assembly Hall , a well-preserved community hall known for its ornate gates, decorative carvings, and traditional Chinese architecture. Visit Phung Hung Ancient House and Tan Ky Ancient House , two historic residences that have been preserved for more than two centuries and reflect the multicultural influences that shaped Hoi An’s trading history. Explore the Museum of Folk Culture , housed in a traditional merchant residence, where exhibits highlight local customs, crafts, and community life throughout the centuries. Depending on the schedule, enjoy a performance at the Hoi An Traditional Performing Arts House , showcasing traditional music and dance. Continue to the Japanese Covered Bridge , one of Hoi An’s most recognisable landmarks and an enduring symbol of the town’s cultural connections. Conclude the tour with time to stroll through the narrow lanes of the Ancient Town, browsing local craft shops, galleries, and artisan workshops.
itineraryDays.title: Half-day Hoi An Walking Tour

itineraryDays.route: Free Day in Hoi An
itineraryDays.summary: Today is free for you to explore Hoi An at your own pace. You may choose to relax, discover the town’s historic streets, sample local cuisine, visit nearby cafés, or browse many artisan shops and boutiques. For those wishing to experience more of the region’s culture and countryside, several optional tours are available. itineraryDays.title: Free Day in Hoi An

itineraryDays.route: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Enjoy breakfast at your hotel in Hoi An, then transfer to Da Nang Airport for a short flight to Ho Chi Minh City (approximately 1.5 hours). Upon arrival, meet your driver and transfer directly to your hotel for check-in. Afternoon The remainder of the day is free at leisure. You may choose to rest at the hotel or explore Ho Chi Minh City independently at your own pace.
itineraryDays.title: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City

itineraryDays.route: Half-day Ho Chi Minh City Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning/ Afternoon Explore some of the most notable landmarks in Ho Chi Minh City on a half-day guided tour. Visit the Reunification Palace , a historic building that once served as the residence of the President of the former Republic of Vietnam. Continue to Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral , a well-known religious landmark featuring neo-Romanesque and Gothic architectural styles, located in the city centre. NOTE : The Notre Dame Cathedral is currently being renovated. Next, explore the Central Post Office , a French-colonial building designed in the 19th century, known for its distinctive European architecture. Visit the War Remnants Museum , which presents exhibitions related to the Vietnam War through photographs, documents, and historical artefacts. After the sightseeing tour, visit a local market where you may explore local goods and practice bargaining. Optional Experiences for the Afternoon/Evening: Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day – Small Group From US $39/pax Dinner Cruise on Saigon River From US $34/pax Saigon Night Life Tour by Motorbike From US $59/pax
itineraryDays.title: Half-day Ho Chi Minh City Tour

itineraryDays.route: Ho Chi Minh City - Mekong Delta Exploration
itineraryDays.summary: Begin your journey with a morning transfer from Ho Chi Minh City to My Tho , a gateway to the Mekong Delta region. On arrival, visit Vinh Trang Pagoda , a well-known Buddhist temple featuring a distinctive blend of Vietnamese, Chinese, and Khmer architectural influences. Continue with a motorized boat trip along the Mekong River toward Tortoise Island , passing fish farms, stilt houses, and local riverside communities. Learn about the traditional “Garden - Pond - Cage” agricultural system used in the region. Stop to enjoy local specialties such as coconut candy and honey tea, served in a traditional setting along the river. At midday, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant featuring regional Mekong Delta cuisine. In the afternoon, continue exploring fruit orchards and experience traditional Southern Vietnamese folk music performed by local artists. Later in the day, transfer to Can Tho for hotel check-in and overnight stay. NOTE : Bicycles are available for free at the lunch stop if you’d like to take a short ride around the area. Please stay close by to avoid getting lost.
itineraryDays.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Mekong Delta Exploration

itineraryDays.route: Cai Rang Floating Market - Ho Chi Minh City
itineraryDays.summary: After breakfast, transfer to the pier and board a traditional wooden boat to visit Cai Rang Floating Market , one of the largest and most active floating markets in the Mekong Delta. Experience the vibrant river scene where local traders sell fruits, vegetables, and daily essentials directly from their boats. Observe the unique trading culture that defines life along the Mekong waterways. Continue the journey with a stop at a local rice noodle workshop , where traditional noodle-making techniques are demonstrated. Enjoy fresh tropical fruit tasting during the visit. Return to the hotel for check-out, then travel back to Ho Chi Minh City. A lunch stop will be served, featuring Vietnamese cuisine. Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City in the afternoon, marking the end of the Mekong Delta experience.
itineraryDays.title: Cai Rang Floating Market - Ho Chi Minh City

itineraryDays.route: Ho Chi Minh City - Flight to Siem Reap
itineraryDays.summary: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. If time permits, you may relax or explore nearby areas in Ho Chi Minh City, such as Ben Thanh Market or local cafes at your own pace. At the scheduled time, transfer to the airport for your international flight to Siem Reap, Cambodia, the gateway to the Angkor temple complex. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and transfer to your hotel for check-in. The evening is free at leisure. You may explore the Siem Reap Night Market, enjoy a local Khmer dinner, or simply rest and prepare for the upcoming temple visits.
itineraryDays.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Flight to Siem Reap

itineraryDays.route: Full-Day Angkor Wat Complex Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, begin a full-day exploration of the Angkor Archaeological Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the historic heart of the Khmer Empire. Start at Angkor Thom (12th century), entering through the South Gate, known for its stone figures representing the Churning of the Ocean of Milk. Continue to Bayon Temple , recognised for its 54 towers decorated with more than 200 carved smiling faces of Avalokitesvara. Proceed to explore the surrounding structures, including Phimeanakas , the Royal Enclosure , the Elephant Terrace , and the Terrace of the Leper King , each reflecting the scale and artistry of Khmer civilisation. Stop for lunch and a short rest. Afternoon Visit Angkor Wat , the largest religious monument in the world and a defining symbol of Cambodia. Built in the 12th century, the complex spans 81 hectares and features five central towers representing Mount Meru in Hindu and Buddhist cosmology. Surrounded by a wide moat and detailed bas-relief galleries, it showcases the height of classical Khmer architecture. After the visit, return to the hotel for leisure time.
itineraryDays.title: Full-Day Angkor Wat Complex Tour

itineraryDays.route: Siem Reap - Banteay Srei
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, depart on a scenic drive of approximately 35 kilometres northeast of Siem Reap to visit Banteay Srei , one of the most exquisite temples in the Angkor region. Built under the guidance of Yajnavaraha, a royal scholar and advisor to King Jayavarman V, Banteay Srei is renowned for its finely detailed carvings and distinctive pink sandstone architecture. Unlike most Angkor temples constructed from volcanic laterite, this material allowed for exceptionally intricate and delicate stonework, making it a masterpiece of Khmer art. On the return journey, stop at Pradark Village , a local community known for traditional palm sugar production. This visit offers insight into rural Cambodian life and long-standing artisanal practices. Return to the hotel around midday for leisure time.
itineraryDays.title: Siem Reap - Banteay Srei

itineraryDays.route: Free Day in Siem Reap
itineraryDays.summary: Today is free for you to explore Siem Reap at your own pace. You may relax at your hotel, explore local markets, enjoy authentic Khmer street food, try a traditional massage, or join a cooking class to experience Cambodian cuisine. For those who prefer guided experiences, several optional tours are available: Optional Experiences: Kampong Khleang – Tonle Sap Half Day From US $80/pax Siem Reap Zipline Half Day From US $118/pax Sunrise at Angkor by Tuktuk & Elephant Ride From US $109/pax
itineraryDays.title: Free Day in Siem Reap

itineraryDays.route: Good Bye, Siem Reap!
itineraryDays.summary: After breakfast, enjoy some free time to pack your luggage and complete check-out at the hotel. At the scheduled time, transfer to Siem Reap International Airport for your onward flight. This marks the end of your journey through Cambodia.

itineraryDays.summary: Morning You can process the checkout after having a delightful breakfast. Take a rest till our guide comes to pick you up at 08:00 . You can immerse yourself in the cool water, or take a stroll around and relax in the natural surroundings. Departing at Lang Co Beach, where the crystal-clear turquoise water meets the pristine white sand and you can enjoy your lunch here with the beautiful atmosphere of the sea. Afternoon Have an adventurous trip passing over the Hai Van Pass , the borderline between Hue and Da Nang City, you are surrounded by clouds on one side with stunning ocean views on the other. When arriving in Hoi An, take yourself to a local restaurant to enjoy dinner, stay overnight at a hotel, and prepare for the next day.

itineraryDays.route: Hoi An Ecotour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning The tour guide will pick you up at around 08:00 after breakfast, then you can start the day by cycling to Cam Thanh Eco Village . There are numerous local experiences for you to try with local hosts: doing farmwork like plowing, raking with buffalo, riding water buffalo, learning how to transplant rice, flooding the farm, grinding rice, and pounding rice. The last morning stop is a local fishing village that offers exciting experiences like fishing with local fishermen and enjoying lunch with local food. Afternoon Our exploration of the coconut palm forest will start at 13:30 . Don’t miss out on the chance to enjoy a basket boat ride - probably the most exciting activity here. After getting back to Hoi An, you have time to explore this charming town on your own. You can wander around the street that is filled with beautiful lanterns, purchase some handcrafted souvenirs, or enjoy regional cuisine. Back to your hotel, take a rest after a super active day and pack your things before the departure the following day.
itineraryDays.title: Hoi An Ecotour

itineraryDays.route: Farewell from Hoi An

itineraryDays.summary: Morning BestPrice tour guide will warmly welcome you at Da Nang International Airport, and then transfer you to your hotel in Da Nang. itineraryDays.route: Ba Na Hills Full-Day Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, our tour guide will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Ba Na Hills , one of the best amusement parks in Vietnam . Check-in at the Suoi Mo Cable Car Station and transfer to Marseille Station. Visit Golden Bridge , also known as the "Hands of God." Marvel at its impressive architectural design and breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. Immerse yourself in the romantic ambiance of Le Jardin D'Amour to explore the beautifully landscaped gardens and enjoy the serene atmosphere. Optionally, visit the Debay Wine Cellar (an additional fee may apply) to indulge in a wine-tasting experience. Learn about Vietnamese winemaking traditions and sample a selection of locally produced wines. Have lunch at a Vietnamese buffet restaurant with over 70 Vietnamese dishes. Afternoon Spend the afternoon at Fantasy Park , a fantastic tourist attraction suitable for the whole family. Engage in various exciting games and activities offered at the park, creating unforgettable memories with your loved ones. Return to the Cable Car Station and back to the Gateway. Transfer back to your hotel.
itineraryDays.title: Ba Na Hills Full-Day Tour

itineraryDays.route: Da Nang - Hue City Full Day
itineraryDays.summary: 07:00 – 07:30 Our car and guide will pick you up at your hotel in Hoi An. Guests in Da Nang will be collected between 08:00 – 08:30 . Begin your journey to Hue with a comfortable and scenic drive, enjoying the changing landscapes along the way. 11:00 Visit the impressive Khai Dinh Tomb , the final resting place of Emperor Khai Dinh. This unique monument showcases a fascinating blend of Vietnamese and European architecture, adorned with intricate mosaics and colorful ceramics. Savor a delicious lunch at a local specialty restaurant, where you’ll enjoy authentic Hue-style dishes, known for their delicate flavors and royal heritage. Afternoon Continue to The Imperial Citadel , Hue’s most iconic landmark and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk through its grand gates, ancient palaces, and temples while learning about the Nguyen Dynasty’s rich history. Explore Thien Mu Pagoda , Hue’s oldest and most revered pagoda, located on a hill overlooking the Perfume River. With its seven-story tower and peaceful gardens, this is a perfect place for reflection and photography. 16:00 Begin the return journey to Da Nang and Hoi An. You will arrive in Da Nang at approximately 18:00 and in Hoi An at around 19:00, marking the end of your Hue Imperial Tour.
itineraryDays.title: Da Nang - Hue City Full Day

itineraryDays.route: Da Nang – Coconut Forest – Hoi An Full Day Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning 07:00 – 07:30 Our driver and tour guide will pick you up from your hotel or designated meeting point to begin an exciting day of exploration. Your first destination is the Son Tra Peninsula , also known as Monkey Mountain by American troops. Rising 693 meters above sea level, this lush national park offers breathtaking panoramic views of the sea and Da Nang city. Here, you will visit Linh Ung Pagoda , home to the tallest Lady Buddha statue in Southeast Asia. The 67-meter-high statue stands gracefully atop a lotus-shaped platform and is adorned with 21 miniature Buddha figures – a truly awe-inspiring sight. Continue the journey to the Marble Mountains , a cluster of limestone hills dotted with pagodas and caves. Explore Am Phu Cave, admire sacred temples, and gain insight into the blend of Buddhism and Hinduism found here. Afterwards, stop at the Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village , famous for its traditional stone sculpture craft, where you can admire exquisite artworks and perhaps pick up a unique souvenir. Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant before continuing to the countryside. Afternoon In the afternoon, head to the Cam Thanh Coconut Village . Surrounded by peaceful greenery, this mangrove forest is a wonderful place to experience rural life. Enjoy a basket boat ride through the water coconut canals, try your hand at traditional round net and cast net fishing, and soak up the serene atmosphere. 14:30 Head to the charming Hoi An Ancient Town , a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Visit highlights such as Phuc Kien Pagoda, Phung Hung Ancient House, the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge, and local museums. Wander through Hoi An Central Market, where vibrant stalls offer handicrafts, spices, and souvenirs. Evening In the evening, enjoy a delightful dinner at a local restaurant before immersing yourself in Hoi An’s magical lantern-lit streets. Take a boat ride on the Hoai River and release a flower lantern to pray for peace and good fortune. Afterwards, explore the bustling night market, filled with colorful lanterns, street food, and traditional handicrafts. 18:30 Transfer back to your hotel in Da Nang or Hoi An, marking the end of your full-day adventure.
itineraryDays.title: Da Nang – Coconut Forest – Hoi An Full Day Tour

itineraryDays.route: Explore Hanoi’s Highlights Half-day (SIC)
itineraryDays.summary: Morning 08:00 - 08:30 : Our guide will meet your group at the hotel, and we will begin our exciting half-day tour in Hanoi, which includes various remarkable well-known attractions: Firstly, we visit the Temple of Literature , which is the first national university of Vietnam. The place is where culture seekers can explore the diverse buildings and gardens that make up the temple complex. One Pillar Pagoda is the second attraction you will head to - a cultural and spiritual attraction processing unique architecture like a beautiful lotus emerging from the water. An essential destination where the Vietnamese pay their respects and express their gratitude to their leader is the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum . It is a must-visit for those interested in Vietnam’s history. Our friendly guide will lead you to the oldest religious temple in the city, Tran Quoc Pagoda . Situated by Hanoi West Lake, the temple strikes a perfect balance of majesty, heritage, and elegance in its architecture. At the end of the venture, your group will enjoy lunch at a local restaurant. itineraryDays.route: Halong Bay - Stay Overnight On An Elegant Cruise
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, our driver will pick you up at 08:00 and head to the cruise port in Halong Bay. At noon, nature goers will be warmly welcomed with a welcome drink, then listen to the cruise introduction and safety guidelines briefly. A delectable lunch will be served on board while the cruise is sailing further to secluded parts of the bay. Afternoon Let’s start our expedition by participating in different exciting activities such as swimming and submerging yourself in the emerald cool water, exploring mysterious caves by kayaking, etc. After returning to the cruise, a Vietnamese cooking class to make local spring rolls will await you. Passengers can also sip a cocktail on sundeck during the afternoon program Happy Hour - Buy 1 Get 1. Evening A tasty dinner is ready to be served at the cruise’s restaurant. Let’s explore the city’s ancient streets, hidden valleys, and savor tasty street food at local vendors.

Depending on the flight time, our driver will pick you up at the hotel and transfer you to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang. Our driver will be waiting for you at Da Nang Airport and drive you to your hotel in Hoi An. Afternoon Welcome to the laidback town - Hoi An! You will have free time for the rest of the day to relax, or spend your leisure time exploring the most charming town in Vietnam, which features a slow pace of life and vintage architecture.
itineraryDays.title: Flight to Da Nang - Head To Alluring Hoi An

itineraryDays.route: Discover Hoi An Ancient Town Half Day
itineraryDays.summary: Morning /Afternoon Let’s get ready for the half-day walking tour today! Start at the bustling Hoi An Market , a sensory feast of sights, colors, sounds, and aromas, perfect for a memorable shopping experience. Next, visit the Phuc Kien Chinese Assembly Hall , with its vibrant gates, intricate dragon statues, and ornate rooftops. Here, you can learn about ancestor worship by observing family altars and locals making offerings. Explore Hoi An’s remarkably preserved old houses, such as Phung Hung Ancient House and Tan Ky Ancient House , which have stood strong for over 200 years. Then, head to the Museum of Folk Culture , housed in a 150-year-old Chinese merchant home, to see artifacts depicting daily life in ancient Hoi An. Don’t miss the Hoi An Traditional Performing Arts House , where you can enjoy local art performances. Stop at the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge , spanning a small canal and built more than 400 years ago to connect the Japanese and Chinese communities. Finally, stroll through Hoi An’s handicraft shops, art galleries, and charming laneways, discovering the local neighborhoods and fully appreciating the town’s timeless charm.
itineraryDays.title: Discover Hoi An Ancient Town Half Day

itineraryDays.route: Say Goodbye To Hoi An - Hue Road Transfer
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, you will have spare time to pack your suitcase before transferring to Hue. It takes about 2 hours on the road to reach the ancient capital. Upon arrival, the hotel staff will welcome you and help you check in. For the rest of the day, you are free to explore the city by yourself. If you need a guide to show you around, why not consider booking one of our fascinating optional tours in Hue: Hue Street Food Tour on Foot From US $28 /pax Taste of Hue by Night on Cyclo From US $49 /pax Hue Authentic Home Dining Experience From US $52 /pax
itineraryDays.title: Say Goodbye To Hoi An - Hue Road Transfer

itineraryDays.route: Half-day Hue City Tour (SIC - Small Group)
itineraryDays.summary: Morning You will be picked up from your hotel at 08:00 - 08:30 to start your city exploration. Today, your group can have the chance to see the best of Hue, from ancient royal architecture to hectic local life. The first well-known attraction in Hue that you will visit is the Thien Mu Pagoda , a famous Buddhist attraction considered the unofficial symbol of the city located at the bank of the enchanting Perfume River. The next journey is to discover the Imperial Citadel , which is one of the remaining Hue Monuments Complex recognized as a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site since 1993. For those who want to get closer to the locals and experience bargaining skills like a local, Dong Ba Market is a great place to visit and buy souvenirs. End of the expedition, the driver will bring you back to your hotel, and the rest of the day is yours. Afternoon For gourmets who are in love with Vietnamese cuisine, please take a look at our optional Hue Night Culinary Tour (From US $48/pax ). Starting at 18:00, you can join an interesting itinerary to try Hue specialties and take a cyclo ride.
itineraryDays.title: Half-day Hue City Tour (SIC - Small Group)

itineraryDays.route: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City - The City That Never Sleeps
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Saying goodbye to Hue must be bittersweet, but we are sure the bustling city you're headed to next will be just as exciting. After having breakfast at the hotel, you will take a 1.5-hour flight to Ho Chi Minh City from Phu Bai Airport. Upon arrival, our driver will wait for you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel in the city center. Afternoon Hope you're enjoying your stay! After checking in, you might want to take some time to unwind and relax. If you're feeling up for it, you could also explore the city and see what it has to offer. As for your night out with BestPrice Travel, here are a few optional suggestions that you might love: Saigon Night Life Tour by Motorbike From US $59/pax Dinner Cruise on Saigon River From US $34/pax Must See Cultural A O Show Saigon Ticket From US $32/pax
itineraryDays.title: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City - The City That Never Sleeps

itineraryDays.route: Cu Chi Tunnels - Ho Chi Minh City Exploration (Small Group)
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, then let’s start your adventure by heading to Cu Chi Tunnels for 1.5 hours! You will have a chance to explore a part of the most complicated underground tunnel system constructed since the Vietnam-American War. Upon arrival, travelers will be introduced to the tunnel constructions and previous usage by watching a documentary movie Next, you will try to go through the tunnel and find out how intricate the 136-mile underground network used by Viet Cong soldiers. Then witness a display of living quarters, meeting room, weapons room, and different types of dangerous traps. After the exploration, active travelers can try shooting real bullets with a wide selection of guns at the range ( additional fee ) At noon, you will have a light lunch at a local restaurant with your group before traveling back to Ho Chi Minh City. Afternoon Afternoon is the time you spend exploring the top must-visit sights of the ‘city that never sleeps’. The first stop is Independence Palace , where the Vietnamese Revolutionary Army won the combat in 1975. Since that day, it has become a significant national monument that stores many historical displays and living residences of South Vietnamese President Nguyen Van Thieu. After around 1.5 hours of exploring, you will move to the next stop at Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral and Central Post Office - two landmarks of the city that are excellent examples of French architecture. Continue visiting the War Remnants Museum dating back to the First Indochina War and the Vietnam War. This place exhibits illustrations of the pointlessness and cruel impacts of the war. End of the sightseeing trip, you will be dropped off at your hotel and be free to explore the city at night. NOTE : The Notre Dame Cathedral is currently under renovation until 2027. You can be taken to visit the surroundings such as the book street.
itineraryDays.title: Cu Chi Tunnels - Ho Chi Minh City Exploration (Small Group)

itineraryDays.route: Thrilling Venture To Mekong Delta Full day (SIC)
itineraryDays.summary: Morning At 08:00 , you will hit the road from Ho Chi Minh City to Ben Tre Province and start the fascinating excursion at the Mekong Delta. Firstly, adventure seekers will have an incredible experience by getting on a boat cruising along the Ham Luong River , where you get to take in the beautiful scenery and see the rustic life of the riverside landscapes. You also have the opportunity to visit local workshops where I witnessed the process of creating coconut products and mat weaving. After that, you take a leisurely stroll through the village - a great chance to see the local culture up close. The cherry on top is to try the unique motorized rickshaw called a ‘ Xe Loi ’, which was a fun and memorable way to get around the countryside. A delicious lunch with local dishes will be served at noon. Food lovers can have an opportunity to taste the delicious deep-fried elephant earfish - a culinary highlight of the trip. Afternoon A sampan trip along the narrow canals would be a unique and memorable experience. The sights and sounds of the waterways, combined with the peaceful atmosphere of being on the water, would make for a relaxing and enjoyable Mekong Delta journey. itineraryDays.route: Life As A Farmer In Tra Que Village - Taste Hoi An’s Flavors on a Food Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast, join a cycle trip to Tra Que organic farm through rice fields and meander village roads. Arrive at the farm and have a short break with a cup of tea in the host family’s house and start ready for farming work. Participating in local farming activities, you will garden together and experience rural life. After a hard and fun day, taste local food for lunch and return to Hoi An ancient town. Afternoon & Night We'll meet you at the designated meeting point to embark on our exciting walking street food tour. NOTE : The dishes featured on each tour may vary unexpectedly. Our culinary journey will begin with a sampling of the crispy delights of spring rolls paired with the creamy richness of egg coffee. Next, we'll meander through the bustling stalls of Hoi An Market, where food enthusiasts can indulge in banh mi or steamed dumplings. Continuing our exploration, we'll treat ourselves to the iconic flavors of Cao Lau, a dish that showcases the culinary essence of Hoi An with its meticulous preparation and unique sauce. Our journey through Hoi An's culinary landscape wouldn't be complete without a taste of Quang Noodles. With its soft, chewy noodles bathed in a flavorful broth, this delicacy promises to leave a lasting impression. As we wander through the charming streets, you can try delicate delights of white rose dumplings (Banh Vac), filled with seasoned minced shrimp pork and served with a delectable dipping sauce. Our adventure will draw to a close as we venture to local eateries to indulge in sweet treats like rich crème caramel, flavorful Che Chuoi (banana with coconut milk), and fluffy sponge cake, providing a fitting finale to our culinary escapade. After the tour, return to your hotel for a cozy overnight stay.
itineraryDays.title: Life As A Farmer In Tra Que Village - Taste Hoi An’s Flavors on a Food Tour

itineraryDays.route: Discover the Sacred Beauty of My Son Sanctuary
itineraryDays.summary: Option : Morning Tour or Sunset Tour Start your journey from Hoi An as your guide takes you to the historic My Son Sanctuary . Set in a peaceful valley, this UNESCO World Heritage Site invites you to explore ancient temple ruins while learning about the Champa civilization, enhanced by a traditional cultural performance. After exploring, continue to a local home to discover how rice paper is made. Try it yourself and enjoy the simple pleasure of tasting your own handmade creation. Then, relax with a home-hosted meal in a tranquil countryside setting, featuring fresh local dishes and herbal tea. Note : For the sunset option, this experience is replaced with a light snack such as banh mi and coconut Later, enjoy a boat trip along the Thu Bon River, taking in the calm scenery as you return to Hoi An, where the tour comes to an end.
itineraryDays.title: Discover the Sacred Beauty of My Son Sanctuary

itineraryDays.route: Escape to Ba Na Hills Full Day
itineraryDays.summary: Morning In the morning, between 07:45 and 08:00 , our bus will pick you up from your hotel after your breathfast, ready to embark on an unforgettable journey to the mesmerizing Ba Na Hills . Our adventure begins with a scenic ride on the Suoi Mo Cable Car, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains as we ascend to Marseille Station . Upon reaching Marseille Station, you'll have the chance to marvel at the Golden Bridge .This iconic bridge, held aloft by two giant stone hands, seemingly floats above the clouds, creating a surreal and magical atmosphere. Our next stop is the enchanting Jardin D’Amour , a meticulously landscaped garden nestled amidst the hills of Ba Na. Here, you'll find a harmonious blend of vibrant flowers, manicured lawns, and tranquil ponds. Afterward, pay a visit the serene Linh Ung Pagoda , immersing yourself in the spiritual ambiance and admiring its intricate architecture. After a morning of exploration and discovery, we'll treat ourselves to a sumptuous lunch at a local Vietnamese buffet restaurant. Afternoon Spend your afternoon at Fantasy Park , a vibrant amusement park located atop Ba Na Hills. As you enter the park, you'll be greeted by colorful rides, thrilling attractions, and lively entertainment, promising endless fun and excitement for visitors of all ages. As the sun begins to set, ascend to King Peak at an altitude of 1,487m, where visitors have the chance to marvel at the breathtaking panoramic views of Ba Na Hills. Finally, return to the Cable Car Station and Gateway in the evening, where our guide will ensure your safe journey back to the hotel, concluding a day filled with unforgettable experiences and memories.
itineraryDays.title: Escape to Ba Na Hills Full Day

itineraryDays.route: Mekong Delta Authentic River Experience
itineraryDays.summary: Morning 08:00: Your tour guide will meet you in the lobby of your hotel, then you will be transferred by car to the pier and get on a luxurious speed boat. 08:15 : When the boat trip begins, you will depart from bustling Saigon city via narrow canals to enter the lush green tributaries of the Mekong Delta. A light breakfast is served on board. We make a quick stop at the beautiful Tuong Van Pagoda , one of Ho Chi Minh City's most famous pagodas. Here, the guide will talk about the importance of Buddhism to the Mekong Delta's inhabitants. Visit a bustling, colorful riverside market full of local specialties and learn about the daily lives of local people. This is also a great opportunity to go shopping for yourself and try delicious tropical fruits. Reach the idyllic watery expanses of the Delta itself, known as the Delta of Nine Dragons for the 9 tributaries that splinter from the main Mekong River, and immerse yourself in the peaceful natural beauty as you pass by fruit orchards and charming rice fields. We will move to the winding canals of the Thu Thua area and chill under the cool shade of a canopy of foliage as you drift along lazily. Depending on the route, you will have 2 options to have a close look at small villages’ life along the river, particularly during your time spent at a local family’s homestead: Option 1: Have a trip to a traditional riverside house and have a chance to see giant Burmese pythons as pets. We will take an expedition to view a Mekong village with surrounding beautiful paddies. Later on, we will head to a traditional farmhouse to sample some cool fresh coconuts and distinct Mekong whisky. Option 2: We will visit a local merchant to have a taste of their range of products, which include authentic Mekong whisky and wine. Relax and wander along the banks of the river to a rural Vietnamese house, then explore the local village where you can taste the freshness of coconuts from the trees. You should take your chance to explore some interesting insights about the Mekong Delta people's life during the tour. NOTE: Our tours are flexible. Your guide may combine parts from both routes. 12:30: Enjoy a traditional Mekong Delta lunch at a restaurant with regional typical cuisine Afternoon We will visit an orphanage run by Buddhist monks and get to know the cute kids if you like. After that, you head to the colorful Cao Dai Temple . The church's uniqueness originates from the merging of religious symbols and pictures of saints from inside to outside. Note : Remember that the temple is usually closed, so you can only see it from the outside. 14:30: Return to your luxury speedboat and depart for Ho Chi Minh City. 16:00: Arrive back in Ho Chi Minh. You will return to your hotel by car. Trip ends.
itineraryDays.title: Mekong Delta Authentic River Experience

itineraryDays.summary: Morning We will get on the Mekong Ecolodge boat and set off to visit the Cai Be market which preserves the Mekong Delta market's traditional cultural activities. Submerge yourself in the market’s liveliness and see local vendors sell fresh sweet fruits on their boats. After floating along the river, we have a chance to visit the Com candy craft village to see how locals make candy nuggets and try this sweet authentic cuisine. We will visit a honey bee farm and refresh our thirst with fresh honey tea. We will continue sailing to Tan Phong Island to explore plenty of local fruit from longan, plum, jackfruit, to durian. Take a break with a cup of tea, fruit, and join the garden folk music exchange with some local garden artists when visiting Uncle 5 On's house . Later on, we will have a chance to experience dinghy sailing in a small canal around Tan Phong island to the Mekong ecolodge. itineraryDays.route: Sa Dec - Can Tho hotel
itineraryDays.summary: Morning After breakfast at the hotel, the bus will pick you up and transport you to Sa Dec town, a well-known floriculture town where you may immerse yourself in the vibrant colors of flowers and tranquil vibe of the rural area. Learn about the long-standing traditional national culture when visiting the Tan Hoa community temple , an 18th-century-built architecture. When visiting Vinh Long, the red brick kingdom, we must stop by one of the brick craft villages. Visit Xeo Vat village and take part in the brick-making process, which is made from clay from the Sa Dec River. After that, you will get the opportunity to learn about the vibrant everyday life of the people in Sa Dec Market , one of the largest markets in the Mekong Delta. At lunch, enjoy the restaurant's regional cuisine. Afternoon This afternoon we will pass by the class learning extant Chinese culture in the Mekong Delta which memorizes an exchange culture period. We will head to the ancient house of Mr. Huynh Thuy Le - a Chinese trader who adored Marguerite Duras - a famous French writer in her youth. That love she wrote a despairing, sensuous novel then adapted to a film of the same name - L'Amant (The Lover). NOTE : Mr. Huynh Thuy Le's ancient house is temporarily closed Following that, we will visit Kien An Cung Pagoda which was built by Huynh Thuy Le's family for a group of Chinese people living in Sa Dec Town for generations, and Trung Vuong Primary School (former Girls' school of Sa Dec) where Marguerite Duras’s mother was the principal. Tonight, we stay overnight at Can Tho Hotel and the rest of our leisure time is yours.
itineraryDays.title: Sa Dec - Can Tho hotel

Afternoon Visit a rice noodle workshop to witness how local people make Vietnamese rice noodles. A shuttle bus takes us back to Sai Gon. End of the trip.

itineraryDays.summary: Morning After a hearty breakfast at the hotel, take in the early morning vibe of Hanoi. Pay a visit to Temple of Literature , the first university in Vietnam, also the symbol of Vietnamese education. Its architecture shows off the influence of Confucianism on Vietnamese history and culture Continue our journey to Ba Dinh Square, where President Ho Chi Minh - the most outstanding leader of the Vietnamese nation, who brought independence to the country, read the Declaration of Independence. The center of the large area is where the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is located. We go along Thanh Nien Road, which is bordered by the glittering West Lake and is considered one of Hanoi's most beautiful thoroughfares, and we stop inside Tran Quoc Pagoda , one of the most important Buddhist structures in Vietnam. At lunchtime, we stop to eat at a local restaurant and indulge in some delectable Vietnamese cuisine. Afternoon Proceed to the suburbs of Hanoi and stroll through Bat Trang Ceramic Village, where families come together in ceramics classes and attempt to create pottery - a messy but enjoyable experience in life. itineraryDays.route: Tea Farm in Tan Cuong - Phuc Triu
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Let's embark on a one-day journey to explore the renowned tea-growing region of Tan Cuong - Phuc Triu, a place deeply rooted in Vietnam's tea culture and rural charm. Upon arrival at the farmstay, you'll begin your morning with a cultural discovery tour through some of the most iconic local landmarks. Your first stop is Dap Nam Ho Nui Coc (Nam Ho Nui Coc Dam), where tranquil waters and lush landscapes offer a peaceful start to your day. Continue on to the Cathedral Tan Cuong , a lesser-known yet striking spiritual site within this peaceful tea-growing region. A visit to Yna Pagoda , perched amid serene surroundings, adds a spiritual touch to the experience. If your trip falls on a market day, you’ll also get the chance to visit Phuc Triu or Phuc Xuan Tea Market , a vibrant local gathering spot where villagers trade fresh tea leaves and daily goods. Around noon, you’ll enjoy a warm and hearty lunch at the farmstay, prepared with fresh local ingredients. This is a chance to taste authentic regional dishes while soaking in the quiet countryside atmosphere. Afternoon Immerse yourself in the traditional tea-making process, guided by local artisans. You’ll join in hands-on activities like tea leaf picking and the unique pan-roasting technique known as “ sao che .” Learn how generations of tea farmers have preserved their craft and enjoy the delicate aromas of freshly processed leaves.
itineraryDays.title: Tea Farm in Tan Cuong - Phuc Triu

Return to the boat on time to enjoy the Happy Hour, which is a small event offering "buy one, get one free" cocktails. It will be held from 17:00 to 17:30 while you watch the beautiful sunset. itineraryDays.summary: Morning Commence your day with a hearty breakfast at your hotel, and at approximately 08:00 , your tour guide will rendezvous with you to embark on a minibus journey to Ky Son Village - an enchanting ancient village in Northern Vietnam. Upon reaching Ky Son Village, settle into your accommodation - a homestay surrounded by a picturesque garden offering captivating views of green paddy fields and Ba Vi Mountain. Immerse yourself in the life of the upland minority culture and their tradition of: Sip a cup of local tea at the homestay and enjoy free time to explore its traditional architectural features. There are surprisingly many things to find in these kinds of houses that are predominantly crafted from wood, and are adorned with ancient patterns such as lotus, phoenix, and dragon. Engage in a cooking class, where you'll learn to prepare delectable Vietnamese dishes like spring rolls or grilled beef in Betel Leaves, followed by a satisfying lunch at the homestay. Afternoon Indulge in a sensory experience as you dip your hands into a refreshing lime bowl filled with traditional aromatic herbs, followed by a soothing hand massage. Embark on a gentle adventure with a scenic bicycle ride through the rustic farming villages of Ky Son, Tam Son, Van Minh, and Cham. Witness daily local life, absorb the serene views of paddy fields, breathe in the fresh air, and immerse yourself in the authentic culture of the region. Upon your return to the homestay, relish the flavors of the area with local products like sweet potato, cassava, peanuts, and traditional Vietnamese desserts. Conclude your day with a delightful dinner featuring local cuisine, and unwind with a comforting herbal foot bath for a serene night's sleep.
itineraryDays.title: Hanoi - Ky Son Village - Sightseeing Biking

itineraryDays.route: Ky Son - Mai Chau - Admire scenery on bicycle
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Embark on your journey to Mai Chau Valley by minibus at 10:00 , enjoying a scenic ride that lasts approximately 2.5 hours, including a brief stop along the way. Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese lunch at noon, with Vegetarian options available. Afternoon Optionally, explore the countryside by bicycle to admire terraced fields and observe local life (Additional cost applies). Spend free time cycling, walking through the village, or shopping for local handicrafts. Immerse yourself in the cultural richness of Mai Chau as you wind down for the night.
itineraryDays.title: Ky Son - Mai Chau - Admire scenery on bicycle

itineraryDays.route: Mai Chau - Ninh Binh - Tam Coc - Bich Dong Pagoda
itineraryDays.summary: Morning At 08:00 , your personal chauffeur will transport you to Ninh Binh, Vietnam's inaugural capital, renowned for its rich historical landmarks. Embark on a bike ride or hop on a buffalo cart to traverse the village, discovering churches, schools, and paddy fields while immersing yourself in the tranquil local life. Afternoon Following lunch, venture to Tam Coc and Bich Dong Pagoda . Glide through three natural caves on a sampan, marveling at the breathtaking natural scenery of towering limestone cliffs, meandering rivers, and picturesque rice paddies. If your visit aligns with the ripe rice season, relish a mesmerizing view of golden-yellow rice fields. Evening Upon concluding the tour, return to your hotel for check-in and enjoy the remainder of the day at your leisure.
itineraryDays.title: Mai Chau - Ninh Binh - Tam Coc - Bich Dong Pagoda

itineraryDays.route: Ninh Binh - Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Between 08:00 and 08:30 , a minibus will transfer you to Halong Bay , a UNESCO World Heritage site located in North Vietnam known for its stunning limestone islands and islets emerging from the emerald waters. The journey to the cruise port takes approximately 2.5 hours. Upon arrival, meet the cruise staff who will guide you through the check-in process and offer a welcome drink as you embark on the cruise. The boarding time is around noon. While cruising through the bay, indulge in a delectable seafood lunch served at the luxurious cruise restaurant. Appreciate the enchanting islets, each with its unique shape, exclusive to Halong Bay. Afternoon : Take a brief break on board to rejuvenate and prepare for an exciting afternoon filled with activities such as kayaking, unwinding on the pristine beach, or exploring Halong's remarkable caves, including Dark & Light Cave and Trung Trang Cave. The specific activities may vary depending on the chosen cruise itinerary. After that, return to the boat, unwind, and relish the enchanting Sunset Party at the cruise bar. Evening A delightful dinner will be served at night. Then passengers will relax and have their first overnight on board. NOTE : Your tour guide will not accompany you on the cruise but will be replaced by crew members fluent in English. Each cruise will have a different itinerary
itineraryDays.title: Ninh Binh - Halong Bay Overnight Cruise

itineraryDays.route: Discover Halong Bay On Cruise
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Commence your day with invigorating Tai Chi exercises on the sundeck, or opt for a Yoga or Vovinam class, depending on the cruise itinerary. Following the morning exercises, board a small boat for a full-day exploration of Halong Bay. As you navigate through the stunning landscapes, absorb the awe-inspiring views and immerse yourself in the natural beauty that surrounds you. Engage in thrilling activities in the bay, such as kayaking, swimming, cave visits, or cycling, contingent on the cruise itinerary. Afterwards, everyone returns to the main boat and savors a delectable lunch at the first-class restaurant. Afternoon Continue your exploration of the renowned attractions in Halong Bay before heading back to the main boat for dinner. Evening As night falls, surrounded by the enchanting beauty of Halong Bay, it is recommended to spend well by staying on board and partaking in lively nighttime activities, including squid fishing, board games, movie screenings, and enjoying drinks at the night bar.
itineraryDays.title: Discover Halong Bay On Cruise

itineraryDays.route: Halong - Hanoi Evening Motorbike Food Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Indulge in a light breakfast aboard the cruise, relishing the serene beauty of the sunrise. Check out and enjoy brunch as you cruise back to the port. Around 11:30 , disembark the cruise, bid farewell to the boat crew, and meet your private driver who will transfer you back to your hotel in Hanoi for check-in. Afternoon Arriving in Hanoi approximately between 15:00 and 15:30 , take some time to relax and recharge for an enchanting street food tour in the evening. Immerse yourself in the vibrant culinary scene of the city and savor the diverse flavors. Evening At 18:00 , our tour guide will pick you up to commence the Hanoi street food tour: First, explore the captivating Hanoi Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem Lake while listening to intriguing stories about the area. Hop on a motorbike journey to discover local eateries. Enjoy Vietnamese coffee and sample some regional snacks. Indulge in dinner at an authentic restaurant. Stroll down a historical street and treat yourself to a traditional Vietnamese sweet dessert, crafted with fresh ingredients and bursting with flavor. Return to your hotel to relax after the delightful night tour.
itineraryDays.title: Halong - Hanoi Evening Motorbike Food Tour

Please contact your travel consultant if you need a late checkout.

itineraryDays.route: Sapa - Cat Cat Village Trekking
itineraryDays.summary: Morning & Afternoon Take a leisurely walk at Cat Cat Village which is well-known not just for its beautiful surroundings, but also for the ethnic mix of its population. You can preserve the beauty of the people and the valley's spectacular natural landscape here via photographs. We'll look at the hidden beauty of a Hydroelectric Power Station . Built by the French in 1925, this is one of the first hydroelectric plants in Vietnam and Indochina. Return to Sapa town by bus. Evening Indulge in a mouthwatering dinner and immerse yourself in Sapa's bustling nightlife. Relax in the cozy comforts of your hotel in Sapa NOTE : The trekking distance: 2.5 km
itineraryDays.title: Sapa - Cat Cat Village Trekking

itineraryDays.route: Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van Village Trekking
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Begin your adventure in Muong Hoa Valley with a 5-kilometer hike through Y Linh Ho Village . When visiting the village, you will view the magnificent Hoang Lien Son mountain range as well as the lovely, innocent ethnic minority children dressed in distinctive brocade clothing. As you approach Lao Chai Village , discover the attractive Black Hmong people and be over the moon by the gorgeous wide angle of terraced fields. We will continue our journey to Ta Van Village , home to the Giay ethnic group, to hear some of the most amazing folk stories. Ta Van Village is home to many different ethnic groups, so this is an excellent opportunity to learn more about their humble way of life. Enjoy a delicious meal at a nearby restaurant. Afternoon The bus will transport you to Sapa Town from Ta Van Bridge , a world-famous gorgeous bridge that crosses the romantic Muong Hoa River. The bridge is formed of native resources such as connected rattan strands gathered from this mountain. Enjoy the freedom to explore the town at your own pace. You can discover the vibrant nightlife of Sapa Town
itineraryDays.title: Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van Village Trekking

itineraryDays.route: Bac Ha Market - Lao Cai - Hanoi
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Start your day by enjoying breakfast and packing up your luggage for check-out. Feel the quintessence and uniqueness of the culture of the Dao, Mong, and Nung ethnic people when visiting Bac Ha Market . Admire the amazing brocade products and buy your loved ones some unique souvenirs. Afternoon After lunch, take a leisurely stroll to Hoang A Tuong's Palace , an exquisite mansion hundreds of years old, and observe the amazing Asian-European architectural style. After that, we'll pay a visit to the Flower H'Mong ethnic group in Ban Pho Village and sample some of their special corn wine. Return to Lao Cai by car, and take some time to unwind before heading back to Hanoi NOTE : The trekking distance: 4 km
itineraryDays.title: Bac Ha Market - Lao Cai - Hanoi

itineraryDays.route: Cu Chi Tunnels - Ho Chi Minh City tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Have breakfast and get ready for an active day to explore Ho Chi Minh's famous attractions. 08:00: Drive to Cu Chi Tunnels and spend the morning exploring this wonderful historical underground location. Upon arrival, watch a documentary film to learn more about the Cu Chi area and its contribution to the Vietnam War. For the adventurous, there's an opportunity to crawl through sections of the narrow tunnels to experience the cramped conditions endured by the soldiers during the war. Another optional activity here that you can experience with a surcharge, is shooting ranges nearby where you can try your hand at shooting a variety of weapons, including rifles and machine guns, under the supervision of trained instructors. Taste special tea and tapioca, the guerilla’s food during the war. End the morning tour with a delicious light lunch. Then return to Ho Chi Minh City. Afternoon Begin your evening exploration by visiting the iconic Saigon Opera House , a splendid architectural gem constructed in 1898 by French architects and still captivating visitors with its timeless elegance since its opening in 1900. Proceed to the exquisite city hall, now known as The People's Committee Hall , which was built by the French colonial administration in the early 1900s. Next, venture to the nearby historic landmarks of Notre Dame Cathedral , a revered symbol of Ho Chi Minh City's religious heritage, and the Saigon Central Post Office , an architectural marvel boasting a blend of Gothic and Renaissance styles. NOTE : Notre Dame Cathedral is temporarily closed for renovation. Visit the colorful Ben Thanh Market , where you may observe locals selling a variety of items and buying souvenirs for your family and friends. Get in our driver’s car and return to your hotel after an active day.
itineraryDays.title: Cu Chi Tunnels - Ho Chi Minh City tour

itineraryDays.route: Ho Chi Minh City - Ben Tre Mekong Delta Full Day
itineraryDays.summary: Morning 07:00 - 07:30 : Begin your journey from Ho Chi Minh City to Ben Tre Province with a convenient hotel pickup. As we drive through the picturesque countryside, enjoy the scenic views of lush forests and experience the rhythm of local life. Upon arrival, embark on a scenic cruise along the Ham Luong River , one of the nine tributaries that form the Mekong Delta. This peaceful waterway offers a serene and picturesque setting, perfect for relaxation and photography. During the cruise, stop by a local coconut workshop to witness the fascinating process of crafting traditional products from coconuts. Engage with friendly artisans, observe their time-honored techniques, and gain deeper insight into Ben Tre's coconut-based culture. Continue with a leisurely walk to a mat-weaving house , where you'll observe the intricate craftsmanship behind this essential household item, which holds cultural and spiritual significance in Southern Vietnam. While there, savor fresh tropical fruits and a warm cup of fragrant local tea. Next, hop aboard a Xe Loi (motorized rickshaw) or bicycle to explore the vibrant countryside. As you journey past lush fruit orchards and peaceful villages, take in the authentic charm of daily life in Ben Tre. Afternoon After a delicious lunch, board a traditional sampan boat and navigate through the narrow, winding canals of the Mekong Delta. The tranquil ride offers a close-up view of the dense greenery and diverse flora lining the waterway, creating a truly immersive nature experience. As the day comes to an end, we will depart for Ho Chi Minh City, arriving back at your hotel by 17:00 , or continuing to your next destination.
itineraryDays.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Ben Tre Mekong Delta Full Day

itineraryDays.summary: Enjoy a slow and refreshing day in Ninh Thuan, one of Vietnam’s most peaceful coastal regions, known for its untouched beaches, clear waters, and laid-back local vibe. Today is all about rest, flexibility, and taking in the natural beauty at your own pace. Start your morning with a relaxed breakfast at the hotel, followed by free time to unwind by the beach or pool. The calm atmosphere makes it perfect for simply soaking up the sun, reading a book, or enjoying the ocean breeze.

itineraryDays.route: Hanoi Half-day Tour - Historical Highlights
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Start your day by enjoying the early morning in Hanoi and having a full breakfast. Your tour guide will collect you at around 08:00 and accompany you for a half-day city tour of Hanoi. The itinerary includes the top must-see attractions in the city. Our first stop is the historical Temple of Literature , the first university in Vietnam, which is considered a symbol of Vietnamese education and culture Next, we will move to explore the One Pillar Pagoda , a unique and iconic Buddhist temple in Hanoi, where you can explore its architecture, history, and religious significance. Continue to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, a solemn and impressive monument that houses the embalmed body of the late Vietnamese leader, Ho Chi Minh, pay your respects to the beloved leader and learn about his life and legacy. Ending with West Lake , the largest freshwater lake in Hanoi, with Tran Quoc Pagoda located on a small island. This temple is one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Vietnam, known for its beautiful architecture and peaceful atmosphere. Before saying goodbye, we will stop for an authentic traditional lunch at a Vietnamese restaurant. NOTE : The tour departs in the morning or afternoon, depending on availability. Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is viewed from outside; closed on Mon and Fri and from Jun to Aug. Afternoon Take the day at leisure, or choose from a range of optional excursions designed to complement your journey. It takes about 2.5 hours on the road to reach this destination. When you arrive, the boat crew will warmly greet you and assist you with the check-in process. When embarking on the cruise, you will be served lunch and have the opportunity to admire the many charming islets of various shapes, the typical scene that only can be seen in Halong Bay. Afternoon You can take a nap after your meal on the boat and prepare yourself for an exciting time during the cruise. Then, you will have the chance to participate in various thrilling activities such as exploring a cave, kayaking, or swimming in the clear water amidst the stunning scenery of Halong Bay, depending on each cruise. Return to the main boat. You will have leisure time to enjoy the beauty of the bay and savor your dinner on the boat. Stay overnight on board. You can experience the nightlife on the cruise by taking part in various activities: card games, squid fishing, karaoke, enjoying cocktails at the bar, etc. NOTE : Our tour guide will not escort you on the cruises and be replaced by crew members who are fluent in English. Return to the boat to check out, prepare your belongings, and savor your last meal onboard. Before 12:00 , the boat docks at the port, and the crew will bid you farewell. itineraryDays.route: Full-day Cu Chi Tunnels & Saigon’s Historic Landmarks
itineraryDays.summary: Morning 08:00: After breakfast, you are picked up by a tour guide at the hotel lobby Explore Cu Chi Tunnel , an extensive network of underground tunnels that were used by the Viet Cong during the Vietnam War as hiding spots, communication and supply routes, and living quarters. Get to know more about how the Vietnamese soldiers lived during the war. You also can engage in an optional shooting range activity, where you can try your hand at firing historical weapons such as AK-47 (with an additional charge) . Have a light lunch at a local restaurant on the way back to Ho Chi Minh City Afternoon 13:30 : Join the sightseeing tour to visit the most popular architectural and cultural sites in Ho Chi Minh City. First, pay a visit to the Reunification Palace , formerly the residence and office of the President of the Republic of Vietnam. This iconic landmark holds significant historical importance, serving as the site where pivotal events unfolded during the Vietnam War era. Then, move to explore the War Remnants Museum , offering insights into the conflicts that shaped Vietnam's history. Through documents, images, and artifacts, the museum provides a sobering glimpse into the impact of war on the nation and its people. Pass by Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral, stands as a symbol of French influence, with its striking Romanesque and Gothic features. NOTE: The Cathedral is temporarily closed for renovation . Then, pay a visit to the Old Post Office , famous for its stunning and grand architecture. This place serves as both a functional hub for postal services and a beloved historical landmark in Ho Chi Minh City. Go shopping and pick up the best souvenirs for your family at home at a local market. Afternoon Spend the rest of the day exploring. You can enjoy the vibrant nightlife of the ‘City that never sleeps’ by yourself, then stay overnight at the hotel.
itineraryDays.title: Full-day Cu Chi Tunnels & Saigon’s Historic Landmarks

itineraryDays.route: Mekong Delta Full-day Discovery
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Picked up by tour guide from the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City around 08:00 , then travel to Ben Tre province to explore the serene vibe of the Mekong Delta. Travel on a boat along the Ham Luong River , which is a branch of the Mekong, to witness the lush scenery of the surroundings on the way. Participate in various options, such as tasting the coconut candy at the coconut processing workshop or trying mat weaving at a mat weaving house. Stop at a quiet village where you can walk to experience the real Delta village life, then get on "Xe Loi", a kind of motorized rickshaw, and travel into the forest to taste the delicious fruits. Have lunch at a riverside restaurant with local specialties such as elephant-ear fish and river shrimp and some cold drinks or beers. Afternoon 13:30 : Board a sampan boat for a relaxing trip along narrow canals. You will have a chance to witness the amazing scenery of the river with water-coconut trees. Back to your hotel in Ho Chi Minh City at around 17:00.
