itineraryDays.route: Discover the Natural Beauty and Culture of Mai Chau Valley
itineraryDays.summary: Morning 07:00 - 07:30 Guests will be picked up from their hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. The journey to Mai Chau takes travelers through winding mountain roads, offering stunning views of lush valleys and traditional stilt houses. Along the way, visitors can observe the daily life of the Muong and Thai ethnic communities, whose villages are nestled harmoniously between the mountains and rice fields. A stop at Thung Khe Pass allows guests to admire the panoramic beauty of Mai Chau Valley. This location is also home to a small roadside market where Muong ethnic people sell fresh produce, local delicacies, and handmade crafts. Lunch will be served at a local restaurant (Vegetarian options are available upon request) Afternoon Guests can choose to participate in optional activities, such as a guided cycling tour to explore the terraced rice fields and learn about the traditional customs of the local people (Additional cost applies) There will also be free time for independent cycling, walking through the village, or shopping for souvenirs. Dinner will feature authentic Thai-style dishes, offering a taste of the region’s culinary heritage. For groups of more than five people, the evening will include a traditional Thai dance performance and an opportunity to enjoy “Ruou Can,” a communal rice wine sipped through bamboo straws.
itineraryDays.title: Discover the Natural Beauty and Culture of Mai Chau Valley

itineraryDays.route: Mai Chau - Visit Remote Na Meo Village - Hanoi
itineraryDays.summary: Distance & Est. time: Cycling 2 km Morning A traditional breakfast will be served at the homestay, allowing guests to start the day with a taste of local flavors. Accompanied by a local Thai guide, guests will embark on a 2 km cycling journey before starting a guided trek to the remote villages of Na Meo, Na Mo , and Xam Pa . This trek offers an immersive experience of the daily life of the Thai ethnic people, providing opportunities to admire vast rice terraces and gain deeper insights into their cultural heritage. Upon returning to the homestay, guests will check out and enjoy a farewell lunch before departure. Afternoon There will be free time to relax, explore the village, or purchase local handicrafts as souvenirs. Around 15:30 - The journey back to Hanoi will commence, with a comfortable drive through the scenic countryside. At roughly - Guests will arrive in Hanoi Old Quarter, where they will be dropped off at their hotel, concluding the two-day tour in Mai Chau.

itineraryDays.route: Explore Hanoi’s Charm - A Half-Day City Tour for Two
itineraryDays.summary: Morning/ Afternoon (Depending on the tour availability) Wake up early and start your day with a tasty breakfast and be ready for your honeymoon trip ahead. At around 08.00 , your friendly tour guide will pick you up and be your companion throughout the Hanoi half-day city tour. Our first stop is the Temple of Literature : step into this ancient Confucian temple, marvel at the stunning architecture, and learn about its historical significance as Vietnam's first national university. Next, visit the One Pillar Pagoda , a unique structure that stands on a single stone pillar. Listen to the fascinating story behind its creation and discover the spiritual importance it holds for the Vietnamese people. Then make our way to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum . Pay your respects to the great leader and learn about his remarkable contributions to Vietnam's independence. NOTE: The mausoleum is viewed outside and temporarily closed on Mon and Fri every week & from Jun - Aug every year. Continues to West Lake , the largest freshwater lake in Hanoi. Take in the serene beauty of the surroundings, and make a stop at Tran Quoc Pagoda , one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Vietnam. At the end of the tour, enjoy a delightful authentic traditional meal at a local Vietnamese restaurant. Evening The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. itineraryDays.summary: Morning After a delicious breakfast, get ready for an enchanting journey to Hoa Lu - Tam Coc in Ninh Binh province. 08:00 - 08:30: Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel and drive you to the beautiful province of Ninh Binh. As you travel, take a moment to breathe in the fresh air while enjoying the picturesque rice fields along the way. Upon your arrival at Tam Coc , a traditional sampan boat ride along the Ngo Dong River to explore the stunning limestone karsts and scenic landscapes. The boat ride lasts for about 2 hours and takes you through three caves - Ca Cave, Hai Cave, and Ba Cave. Immerse yourself in the tranquility of the surroundings as your boat gently glides through the winding river. Around noon, stop at a local restaurant and enjoy the local special cuisine in Ninh Binh. Afternoon It's time to discover the ancient capital of Vietnam, Hoa Lu , which dates back a thousand years. You will have a chance to visit the temples of King Dinh and King Le here. 18:30 - 19:00 : Your driver will transfer you back to your hotel in Hanoi.
itineraryDays.title: Hanoi - Romantic Escape to Hoa Lu & Tam Coc (Ninh Binh)

itineraryDays.route: Hanoi - Halong Bay - Romantic Overnight On Cruise
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Around 08:00 - 08:30 , our driver will pick you up for a scenic journey to Halong Bay , a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its awe-inspiring natural beauty. The drive will take approximately 2.5 hours. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by the friendly boat crew, who will assist you with the check-in process. The cruise tour starts at around 12:00. Enjoy a delightful lunch with fresh seafood as you cruise through the bay and admire the picturesque islets of various shapes that only can be seen in Halong Bay. Afternoon Take a short break after your meal and get ready for various activities in the afternoon, such as kayaking, swimming, and cave visiting, depending on the day's cruise itinerary. Return to the cruise, enjoy the sunset bar on the boat, and enjoy a delicious dinner at around 19:00 - 19:30 . There are still many exciting nightlife activities that you could join with your partner on board, such as squid fishing, board games, movie watching, night bar, etc. NOTE : The detailed itinerary will be provided depending on each cruise. Our tour guide will not escort you on the cruises and be replaced by crew members who are fluent in English.
itineraryDays.title: Hanoi - Halong Bay - Romantic Overnight On Cruise

itineraryDays.route: Fly to Da Nang - Journey to the Charming Hoi An
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Start your day with a Tai-chi class on the deck of the cruise ship, or simply wake up early to witness the stunning sunrise over Halong Bay. Then enjoy a light breakfast served at 07:00 . Afterward, continue to visit one of the magnificent caves in Halong Bay or go kayaking to explore the bay's natural beauty. Return to the boat at 10:00 for check-out. Then enjoy a delicious final meal on board. Between 11:30 and 11:45 , the boat will arrive at the port, and the crew will bid you farewell. Our shuttle bus will be waiting to transfer you back to your hotel in Hanoi. Afternoon Your driver will transfer you back to Hanoi for the flight to Da Nang City. Upon your arrival at Da Nang, take a 45-minute ride to the hotel in Hoi An. The rest of the day is your private time to relax and prepare for the next exciting day.
itineraryDays.title: Fly to Da Nang - Journey to the Charming Hoi An

itineraryDays.route: Discover Hoi An’s Magic - Half-Day City Tour
itineraryDays.summary: Morning Your visit begins at the lively Hoi An Market , a colorful hub filled with local produce, handicrafts, and the energetic rhythm of daily life. Just nearby is the Phuc Kien Chinese Assembly Hall , known for its striking gates, dragon sculptures, and ornate rooftops. Here, you’ll learn about ancestor worship as you observe the family altar and watch locals making their offerings. You’ll then explore some of Hoi An’s beautifully preserved old houses, such as Phung Hung or Tan Ky , both standing strong for more than 200 years. Continue to the Museum of Folk Culture , set inside a 150-year-old former merchant house, where displays illustrate traditional life in ancient Hoi An. You’ll also enjoy cultural performances at the Hoi An Traditional Performing Arts House . Next, visit the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge , a 400-year-old structure that once linked the Japanese and Chinese communities across a small canal. To complete your walk, browse Hoi An’s handicraft shops and art galleries, and wander through charming alleys and local neighborhoods to fully appreciate the town’s timeless charm.
